WITH GrossProfit AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.LineTotal) - SUM(l.Quantity * p.UnitCost) AS GrossProfit
    FROM sales.Orders o
    JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
    JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId
    WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
), Revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue
    FROM sales.Orders o
    JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
    WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025
)
SELECT 100.0 * GP.GrossProfit / NULLIF(R.Revenue, 0) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM GrossProfit GP, Revenue R

SELECT w.Name, COUNT(o.OrderId) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate 
FROM sales.Orders o 
JOIN inventory.Warehouses w ON w.WarehouseId = o.WarehouseId 
WHERE o.Status = 'Returned' 
GROUP BY w.Name

sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN ol.LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS Q2_2026_Revenue 
FROM sales.Orders o 
JOIN sales.OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId 
WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2026 AND MONTH(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN 4 AND 6

SELECT 
    (583094.25 - 471899.64) * 100.0 / 583094.25 AS RevenueChangePct
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderDate >= '2026-07-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-08-01' THEN ol.LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS July2026Revenue, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderDate >= '2025-07-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2025-08-01' THEN ol.LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS July2025Revenue 
     FROM 
        sales.OrderLines ol 
     JOIN 
        sales.Orders o ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId 
     WHERE 
        o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')) AS RevenueSummary

SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.ListPrice) AS TotalStockValue 
FROM inventory.Stock s 
JOIN catalog.Products p ON s.ProductId = p.ProductId

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductId) AS ActiveProductsOutOfStock 
FROM catalog.Products p 
JOIN inventory.Stock s ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId 
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 0 AND s.QuantityOnHand = 0

SELECT SUM(o.ShippingFee + ol.LineTotal) AS OutstandingAmount 
FROM sales.OrderLines ol 
LEFT JOIN sales.Orders o ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId 
LEFT JOIN sales.Payments p ON o.OrderId = p.OrderId 
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') AND p.OrderId IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount 
FROM sales.Orders 
WHERE OrderDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1) 
AND OrderDate < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1, 1, 1) 
AND Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(hour, o.OrderDate, o.ShippedDate)) AS AvgOrderToShipTime 
FROM sales.Orders o 
WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
